question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **relies**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"relies"** means to depend on with full trust or confidence. (निर्भर करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She relies on her friends for emotional support.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **'relies'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Creates **(सृजन करना): To bring something into existence.

 
 
• **Example:** She creates amazing digital art.
 
 
 
• **Hopes **(आशा करना): To want something to happen or be the case.
 
 
• **Example: **He hopes to win the lottery.
 
 
 
• **Wants** (चाहना): To have a desire to possess or do something.
 
 
• **Example:** She wants a new car.
